meta.description: Board graph for the campaign: every location that exists on the start board or is revealed later, plus the 17 sea lanes printed at the start, 10 lines printed on region/city stickers, and documented player-drawn routes. Verified against docs/assets/.

conventions.kind: city has City and Infection cards and can hold a supply center; haven is a sea location with no cards, is never infected, always counts as a production site and cannot be the end of a supply line.
conventions.color: Card color of the city (blue, yellow, black, or red); null for havens.
conventions.startingPopulation: Population printed on the board or on the region sticker when the location appears. Range 0-8.
conventions.coastal: Port location (anchor symbol). Only ports can use Sail, Charter Boat and Chart Sea Lane.
conventions.infested: Printed infested marker on the region sticker. Starting a turn in an infested city exposes the character, like a Plague cube does.
conventions.routes: Supply lines and sea lanes are drawn by the players during the campaign. Only the printed starting sea lanes and the lines printed on region stickers start established. Every other route listed here was built in a documented campaign and is a legal candidate, not a fixed edge. The engine should let players draw any route that passes the geometric rules in legacy-timeline.json (Establish Supply Line, Chart Sea Lane).
conventions.regionLines: Red region lines on the printed board limit sea lanes: a sea lane may cross at most one red line. Printed red lines: south of South America at the Drake Passage (base board, also blocks the Magellan Strait), south of Africa at 20E (door 57), along 100W south of Central America (door 60), along the Somali coast west of the Indian Ocean haven (door 65), diagonally from Ho Chi Minh City across Borneo to Australia (door 63), along 20N east of Taiwan (door 56), and along 20S east of Queensland (door 59). The engine keeps them in redLines in packages/game/src/content/world.ts.

regions.label: Atlantic basin
regions.reconCost: Explored at start. Holds the three starting havens and the nine starting cities.

regions.label: North America interior and west coast
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Washington. Discard any 3 blue City cards (duplicates allowed). Opens Package 1 (doors 66, J, 23, L, 39). Chicago joins the grid at once by a printed supply line from Washington. Forced at February setup (02-01) if 66 is sealed.

regions.label: South America west and south
regions.reconCost: Supply center in São Paulo. Discard any 4 yellow City cards (duplicates allowed). Opens Package 5 (doors 67, J, 23, L, 39). Buenos Aires joins the grid at once by a printed sea lane from São Paulo. Forced at April setup (04-01) if 67 is sealed.

regions.label: Northern and eastern Europe
regions.reconCost: Supply center in London. Discard 4 unique blue City cards. Opens Package 4 (door 64). Paris joins the grid at once by a printed supply line from London. Forced at June setup (06-01) if 64 is sealed (also opens door 21, permanently destroying Frankfurt).

regions.label: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Lagos. Discard 5 unique yellow City cards. Opens Package 7 (doors 57, F, 14). Kinshasa joins the grid at once by a printed supply line from Lagos. Forced at July setup (07-01) if 57 is sealed.

regions.label: Middle East and South Asia
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Cairo. Discard 4 unique black City cards. Opens Package 2 (doors 62, 53, F, 14). Baghdad joins the grid at once by a printed supply line from Cairo. Forced at August setup (08-01) if 62 is sealed.

regions.label: East and Southeast Asia
regions.reconCost: Recon spot at Kolkata is added by door 52 (revealed by Frequency Scanner box 9.2). Supply center in Kolkata; discard 5 unique black City cards. Opens Package 3 (doors 56, 63). Jakarta joins the grid at once by a printed sea lane from Kolkata. Forced at October setup (10-01) if 56 and 63 are not both open (also scars 1 chosen character).

regions.label: Southwest Pacific
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Jakarta. Discard any 2 red City cards (duplicates allowed). Opens door 59, revealing the ruined Coral Sea haven (pop 1) and its sea lane from Jakarta.

regions.label: New Zealand
regions.reconCost: Recon from the ruined Coral Sea haven (no supply center needed). Discard any 2 red City cards (duplicates allowed). Opens door 19 (which opens doors 51 Wellington, 41 Vector Control Expert, 61 Lake Baikal, 13 Breakthroughs, and 30 Lab markers).

regions.label: Eastern Pacific lost haven
regions.reconCost: Not a recon. Revealed (door 60) by sea search on Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Lima, or forced at May setup (05-01). Printed sea lane connects southeast toward Lima. First pawn arrival names it and opens Package 6.

regions.label: Western Indian Ocean lost haven
regions.reconCost: Not a recon. Revealed (door 65) by sea search on New Mumbai, Antananarivo, or Dar es Salaam, or forced at September setup (09-01). Reached by charting a sea lane. First pawn arrival names it and opens door 11 (+4 actions, up to 15 reserve cubes to stockpile, Area 11 +15).

regions.label: Inner Asia (walled region)
regions.reconCost: Blocked by wall until Hollow Men defect (door 17 → door 58 gap). Completing all 4 steps of The Plan in Shanghai (no SC: 5 unique red, 4 unique black, 3 unique yellow, 3 unique blue) opens Package 8 (or forced in December 12-01): places Utopia (pop 8, printed supply line from Shanghai) and opens door 61 (Lake Baikal). Establish a supply line from Utopia to Lake Baikal; first arrival opens door 22 (PEARL).

cities.name: North Atlantic Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven. Players name it at campaign start. Character homes are chosen among the named havens.

cities.name: Mediterranean Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven in the western Mediterranean. The rulebook's Sail example from London to Cairo routes through it.

cities.name: South Atlantic Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven near the equator between Brazil and West Africa.

cities.name: Eastern Pacific Haven
cities.notes: Lost haven (door 60, pop 3). Revealed by sea search in Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Lima, or forced in May (05-01). First pawn arrival names it and opens Package 6 (15 new Supply cubes, Area 10 +15, Rule B, Rule I Inoculate, 3 Portable Antiviral Labs).

cities.name: Indian Ocean Haven
cities.notes: Lost haven (door 65, pop 3, at 0° 60°E). Revealed by sea search in New Mumbai, Dar es Salaam, or Antananarivo, or forced in September (09-01). First pawn arrival names it and opens door 11 (+4 actions, up to 15 reserve cubes to stockpile, Area 11 +15).

cities.name: Coral Sea Haven (ruined)
cities.notes: Ruined lost haven (door 59, pop 1, east of Australia). Revealed by Jakarta recon (2 red at SC). Connected by sea lane from Jakarta; hosts recon to New Zealand (2 red, duplicates allowed, no SC needed → door 19).

cities.name: New York
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Washington
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for North America.

cities.name: Jacksonville
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Sao Paulo
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for South America.

cities.name: London
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for Europe.

cities.name: Istanbul
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Tripoli
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Cairo
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for the Middle East.

cities.name: Lagos
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for Africa.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when North America opens (printed supply line from Washington). Search: put up to 2 stockpile cubes into Chicago.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.notes: Land search: put 3 reserve cubes into San Francisco. Sea search: open door 60 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Denver
cities.notes: Search: Companion Logistics Expert (Establish Supply Line costs 1 fewer cube while held).

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.notes: Search: move 1 Infection discard card to Game End.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.notes: Land search: move 4 reserve cubes to stockpile. Sea search: open door 60 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Mexico City
cities.notes: Search: Companion Scout (action: discard a City card incl. this to take a same-color City card from Player discard).

cities.name: Bogota
cities.notes: Search: take 1 card from Player discard into hand.

cities.name: Lima
cities.notes: Land search: Companion Herbalist (play at any time to remove 1 Plague cube from your location). Sea search: open door 60 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Santiago
cities.notes: Search: open door 50 if sealed and mark Santiago infested.

cities.name: Buenos Aires
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when South America opens (printed sea lane from São Paulo). Land search: OPAL lab (open doors 18 and 20). Sea search: put 3 reserve cubes into Buenos Aires.

cities.name: Paris
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when Europe opens (printed supply line from London). Search: Companion Engineer (Build Supply Center costs 1 fewer card while held; may spend this card).

cities.name: Frankfurt
cities.notes: Search: Companion Messenger (free action: move Supply cubes from an adjacent location into yours while held). Permanently destroyed by door 21 if Europe is forced open in June (06-01).

cities.name: St. Petersburg
cities.notes: Land search: Companion Operative (Search is free while held). Sea search: draw a free sea lane from St. Petersburg.

cities.name: Moscow
cities.notes: Black city in Europe. Search: give 1 Player card from hand to another player.

cities.name: Kinshasa
cities.notes: Printed infested. Joins the grid automatically when Africa opens (printed supply line from Lagos). Search: Companion Technician (Build Satellite Tower costs 1 fewer cube while held).

cities.name: Khartoum
cities.notes: Printed infested. Search: give 1 Player card from hand to another player.

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.notes: Printed infested. Land search: draw a free supply line from Dar es Salaam. Sea search: open door 65 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Antananarivo
cities.notes: Land search: Companion Containment Specialist (play to remove all Plague cubes from 1 grid location). Sea search: open door 65 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Johannesburg
cities.notes: Search: JADE lab (open doors 46 and 20). Final objective destination: carrier must reach Johannesburg while it holds a supply center.

cities.name: Baghdad
cities.notes: Printed infested. Joins the grid automatically when Middle East opens (printed supply line from Cairo). Search: gain 2 actions.

cities.name: Riyadh
cities.notes: Search: take 1 Player card from discard into hand.

cities.name: Tehran
cities.notes: Search: remove up to 2 Hollow Men figures from the board.

cities.name: Delhi
cities.notes: Printed infested. Search: Companion Vector Control Technician (no exposure for starting a turn in an infested city while held).

cities.name: New Mumbai
cities.notes: Printed infested. Land search: gain 1 action. Sea search: open door 65 (or +1 action if already open).

cities.name: Kolkata
cities.notes: Printed infested. No search box. Door 53 adds recon placeholder; door 52 adds East Asia recon (5 unique black at SC → Package 3).

cities.name: Jakarta
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when East Asia opens (printed sea lane from Kolkata). Recon spot for Coral Sea (2 red at SC → door 59). Search: Companion Builder (play at any time to place a shelter on 1 grid city).

cities.name: Bangkok
cities.notes: No search box.

cities.name: Ho Chi Minh City
cities.notes: No search box.

cities.name: Manila
cities.notes: Printed infested. No search box.

cities.name: Hong Kong
cities.notes: Port on board map sticker (door 56); Player card compass omits anchor (publisher misprint). Search: Companion Structural Engineer (Build Shelter may discard any color while held).

cities.name: Shanghai
cities.notes: Printed infested. Port on board map sticker (door 56); Player card compass omits anchor (publisher misprint). Search: story only (no game effect). Site of The Plan recons in November (no SC required).

cities.name: Seoul
cities.notes: Search: draw a free sea lane from Seoul.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.notes: Printed infested. Search: Companion Spies (counts as 2 unique red cards for Recon).

cities.name: Osaka
cities.notes: Printed infested. Search: Companion Local Resistance (play at any time to remove 1 Hollow Man anywhere on grid).

cities.name: Wellington
cities.notes: Blue port city at pop 2 (door 51, opened by door 19). Connected by sea lane from Coral Sea haven. Holds the TOPAZ lab. No Player or Infection cards.

cities.name: Utopia
cities.notes: Red inland city at pop 8 (Package 8 map sticker; Player card compass misprints anchor). Not printed infested; cannot be improved. Connects via printed supply line from Shanghai; puts 8 Infection + 4 Gather cards in Infection discard. Search: Companion Informant (play at any time to move up to 4 Utopia Infection discards to Game End).

cities.name: Lake Baikal
cities.notes: Red inland city at pop 1 (door 61). Holds the PEARL lab (first arrival opens door 22 → Q, 38, 27, 32). Connected by establishing a supply line from Utopia. No Player or Infection cards.
